units.title: SG-5.1 Layer order, render context, SceneObject and buildScene
Act: Add layers and renderContext engine modules
units.failure: Act agent reported ok:false: Created game/src/engine/layers.ts (LAYER_ORDER, layerDepth) and game/src/engine/renderContext.ts (RenderHandle, RenderSpriteSpec, RenderContext) exactly as Steps 1 and 2 specify, importing Layer from content/schema.ts. Baseline: approved scan v1, tip 9cda5131c65b08541fc685d8a0898d39a0e9e9fa; refreshed discovery tip 3c9929aef30ef08f06a92552b6680599f4a900fb. Ran `npm ci` in game/ (lockfile, 47 packages). `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 2, so the Step 2 expected result ('passes') is NOT met. None of the errors are in the two new files. They are pre-existing: (a) every `node:fs`/`node:path`/`node:url`/`node:os` import and `__dirname` fails because @types/node is not declared in game/package.json; (b) tests/persistence.test.ts(63) has a GameState type mismatch between src/state/persistence and src/state/types (inventory unknown[] vs string[]). I did not change package.json or any tests, since those are outside this unit's write scope or owned by Verify. Fixing (a) needs @types/node added to devDependencies, which is a separate decision. No Atlas files were touched.

units.title: Verify: Layer order and render context unit tests

tests.name: tests/layers.test.ts > layers > LAYER_ORDER is the six layers in order
tests.title: LAYER_ORDER is the six layers in order
tests.scenario: Given the layers module, When LAYER_ORDER is read, Then it equals background, furniture, objects, characters, effects, ui
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/layers.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/layers.test.ts > layers > layerDepth increases per layer and falls back
tests.title: layerDepth increases per layer and falls back
tests.scenario: Given LAYER_ORDER, When layerDepth is called per layer, Then depths strictly increase; and layerDepth(undefined) and layerDepth('nope') equal layerDepth('objects')
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/layers.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: SceneObject entity unit tests with fake context

tests.name: creates exactly one sprite with key, position, scale and layer depth on construction
tests.title: SceneObject creates exactly one sprite with key, position, scale and layer depth on construction
tests.scenario: Given a fake RenderContext and an object spec on the furniture layer, When SceneObject is constructed, Then createSprite is called once with key, x, y, scale and depth layerDepth('furniture')
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sceneObject.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: hides and then shows the sprite as the visibleWhen flag is set
tests.title: SceneObject hides and then shows the sprite as the visibleWhen flag is set
tests.scenario: Given visibleWhen [{flag:'a'}] and flags {}, When sync runs, then setFlag a=true and sync runs again, Then setVisible(false) followed by setVisible(true)
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sceneObject.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: destroys the render handle exactly once on destroy
tests.title: SceneObject destroys the render handle exactly once on destroy
tests.scenario: Given a constructed SceneObject, When destroy is called, Then handle.destroy is called once
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sceneObject.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: buildScene ordering and count unit tests

tests.name: orders the returned objects background, furniture, objects regardless of input order
tests.title: buildScene orders the returned objects background, furniture, objects regardless of input order
tests.scenario: Given a scene with objects on layers objects, background, furniture; when buildScene runs; then result layers are background, furniture, objects
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/buildScene.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: creates exactly one sprite per authored object
tests.title: buildScene creates exactly one sprite per authored object
tests.scenario: Given a scene with three objects; when buildScene runs with a fake context; then createSprite is called 3 times
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/buildScene.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: returns an empty list and creates no sprites when the scene has no objects
tests.title: buildScene returns an empty list and creates no sprites when the scene has no objects
tests.scenario: Given a scene with objects []; when buildScene runs; then the result is [] and createSprite is not called
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/buildScene.test.ts --testTimeout=10000
